content:
**Canned Dog Food** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*, with the brand "Doghouse Beef Stew Dog Feed".

Being a canned product, this product does not spoil over time nor does it carry any risk of disease.

- The largest source of easily acquired cans is Mama Dolce's Food Processing during the event Event: Feed the People.
- One can be found inside Garrahan Mining Headquarters.

- The Carnivore mutation will positively affect this. Removing the rads and improving food and HP restoration.
- The Good Doggy Perk will positively affect this. Improving food and HP restoration.
- The Slow Metabolizer Perk will positively affect this. Improving food restoration.

| Cards/ Mutations | Rads | HP | Food | 
| (base food) | 1 | 25 | 10% | 
| **Good Doggy** | 1 | 75 | 30% | 
| *Carnivore* | 0 | 50 | 20% | 
| **Good Doggy**Slow Metabolizer (1) | 1 | 75 | 45% | 
| **Good Doggy***Carnivore* | 0 | 150 | 60% | 
| **Good Doggy***Carnivore*Slow Metabolizer (1) | 0 | 150 | 90% |
